annotations.title: SEC filings (EDGAR) by ticker: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and Form 4 for a US public company

description: Latest SEC EDGAR filings for a US-listed company by stock ticker or CIK: form (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1…), filing and report dates, accession number, document description and a direct link, newest first, optionally only one form type. Plus company name, CIK and industry (SIC). Public SEC data. Use to check a company's latest annual or quarterly report, insider trades (form 4) or material events (8-K). Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (instead of ticker)

form.description: Only this form type, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 4 (default: all)

ticker.description: Stock ticker such as AAPL (or give cik)
